notes: Fascia sign over the black spiral-rod grille: 'Neek' in sky-blue flat-cut letters (bold condensed sans, leaning slightly forward; Fjalla One sheared 0.12 matches the shapes), a small gold '&' and a gold monoline script 'Co.'
